   $$E = qV = (1.602 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}) \times 2.5\text{ V} = 4.005 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}$$

   $$E_{\text{mol}} = E \times N_A = (4.005 \times 10^{-19}\text{ J}) \times (6.022 \times 10^{23}\text{ mol}^{-1}) = 241.2\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

   * $\text{C}-\text{F}$ ($467\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$) $> 241.2\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$ (cannot be cleaved)

   * $\text{C}-\text{I}$ ($228\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$) $< 241.2\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$ (can be cleaved)
